description: Returns the MindDory setup for this conversation: the user's CEFR level, target and source languages (with regional variant), due-card count, weak words, and the capture guidance for their language. `lang` scopes the result to one practice language (ISO or BCP-47, e.g. en-gb); without it the user's primary learning language is used.

lang.description: Optional ISO or BCP-47 tag of the language the user wants to practice in this conversation (en, en-us, de, pt-br). Defaults to the user's primary learning language.

name: get_system_instructions
title: Get session instructions
